note: Management controls (docs/05 §7.3, docs/06). Human-edited; every change must be its own commit — the commit IS the audit event. kill=true blocks every order and freezes cycles. pause_entries=true blocks new buys; exits still flow. excluded_symbols blocks buys of a name and, if it is held, sells it in full at the next open (a forced exit); sales are never blocked. gross_cap (0..1) caps gross exposure: a breach holds the night for a human.
